claims.source_quote_ar: (ذوقوا) فعل أمر مبنيّ على حذف النون.. والواو فاعل
claims.claim_ar: فعل الأمر «فَذُوقُوا» يُستعمل هنا كأسلوب حكيم تحذيري/تهديدي يربط البيان بعاقبة محددة.
claims.claim_en: The imperative 'فَذُوقُوا' functions here as a rhetorical commanding style (asloob hakim), a warning/threat that ties the statement to a definite punitive outcome.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted source is grammatical (identifies the verb form); mapping that grammatical fact to the specific rhetorical function (warning/imperative-as-stylistic-threat) is an interpretive step that should be reviewed.

claims.claim_ar: أداة الاستثناء «إِلَّا» هنا تعمل كقصر/حصر؛ توضح أن ما يَحْدُث (صلاتهم) محدود ومحصور في كونه صوتًا بلا معنى (مستبعدٌ عن الصدق والفاعلية).
claims.claim_en: The exception particle 'إِلَّا' functions as restriction/limitation (hasr/qasr), confining what is described (their prayer) to mere sound (excluding any real efficacy or sincerity).
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting chunk shows the use of 'إِلَّا' as an excluding particle in another verse ('إلا الكفار'); applying that general function to this specific ayah is plausible but inferential and should be reviewed in light of full tafsir.

claims.source_quote_ar: (ما) موصول مفعول به على حذف مضاف أي جزاء ما كنتم
claims.claim_ar: الضمير/أداة «ما» في «بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ» تعمل كموصول يدل على العلة/السبب (جزاء ما كنتم)؛ البنية ترسّخ رابط السببية بين الكفر والعقاب.
claims.claim_en: The 'ما' in 'بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ' is a relative/nominal connector ('ma' as a relative) functioning to indicate the object/reason—linking their disbelief to the resulting punishment; the construction emphasizes the causal relation.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted chunk discusses the grammatical status of 'ما' as a relative/object in a related commentary; labeling this specific connective as 'ijab_inshaa' and as a rhetorical device (causal emphasis) is interpretive and uncertain—needs specialist review.
